**Fully Furnished 2 Bed, 2 Bath Condo – Downtown Vancouver**

Beautiful 900 sq. ft. corner unit with stunning city and water views, located in the heart of Downtown Vancouver. Fully furnished with 2 queen beds, equipped kitchen, in-suite laundry, Wi-Fi, portable AC, and secure underground parking.

Building amenities include an indoor pool, gym, sauna, steam room, and hot tub. Prime location steps from SkyTrain, Costco, Rogers Arena, BC Place, restaurants, and shopping.
